title: AppSec Core: An Ontology for Security-by-Design Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.23312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When engineers or coding agents change an application, a dependency, a configuration or a build pipeline, they need to know three things: which security rules apply, how to meet them, and what evidence to leave. Today the answers are spread over many standards, frameworks, laws and lists of weaknesses, and each one uses its own words and level of detail. This paper presents AppSec Core, a model of the security work that engineers do. It says what must be true, which practices get there, which mechanisms do the job and which artefacts show that it was done. It has 259 elements in ten domains. We built it from a security-by-design manual written from practice, and then checked it against 31 outside sources, ten of them about AI systems and agents. translated_title: AppSec Core：面向安全设计软件工程的本体
translated_abstract: 当工程师或编码智能体更改应用程序、依赖项、配置或构建流水线时，他们需要知道三件事：哪些安全规则适用、如何满足这些规则，以及应留下什么证据。如今，这些答案分散在众多标准、框架、法律和弱点列表之中，而每个来源都使用自己的术语和不同详细程度的表述。本文提出了AppSec Core，一个描述工程师所从事安全工作的模型。它说明了必须满足什么目标、通过哪些实践来达成目标、哪些机制来完成工作，以及哪些工件可以证明工作已经完成。该模型包含十个领域中的259个元素。我们基于一份源自实践的安全设计手册构建了该模型，然后将其与31个外部来源进行核对，其中十个涉及AI系统和智能体。在此过程中我们做了三处修改，增加了五个目标并扩展了一个领域的范围，但无需新增领域。大多数目标都有多个来源的支持：典型的目标由u……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了AppSec Core——一个涵盖十个领域、共259个元素的安全设计软件工程本体模型，它将分散在众多标准、框架和法律中的安全要求统一为“目标—实践—机制—证据工件”的结构化表示，并基于31个外部来源（含10个AI相关来源）进行了验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AppSec Core, an ontology of 259 elements across ten domains that unifies security requirements scattered across standards, frameworks, and laws into a structured model of objectives, practices, mechanisms, and evidence artifacts for security-by-design software engineering, validated against 31 external sources including ten on AI systems.
